items.label: 4-in-1 Connection Ways & Multi-platform Compatibility
items.value: Enjoy wireless gaming through 2.4GHz, USB, Bluetooth, or 3.5mm wired connection. Leveraging a 2.4GHz connection through its USB dongle, this gaming headsets ensures consistent gameplay for PCs and many consoles. Support Xbox One , PC, Nintendo Switch, PS4/PS5, Laptop, Tablet, iPad, Computer, Mobile Phone.【PS: Supports Xbox game console with 3.5mm audio jack, suitable for Xbox One model】

items.label: Clear Calls
items.value: Featuring an ENC (Environmental Noise Cancellation) microphone, the noise-cancelling headphones ensure your voice comes through clearly on calls, even in loud surroundings. The closed-back earcups with plush memory foam cushions create a tight seal around your ears, providing excellent passive noise isolation. This wireless headset (fully compatible with PS5) delivers crisp audio transmission, giving you a competitive edge in every match.

items.label: Immersive Stereo Sound with Virtual 7.1 Support
items.value: Engineered with oversized 40mm dynamic drivers and highly-flexible silk diaphragms, these Xbox One headsets deliver powerful, deep bass and exceptionally crisp treble for stunning clarity. Experience lag-free audio (under 20ms) and rock-solid connectivity up to 55 ft. GS400 Ultra wireless gaming headphones are the perfect audio gear for capturing every critical detail in competitive games like Fortnite/starfield/Call of Duty/PUBG.

items.label: 40 Hrs Playtime & Adjustable for Perfect Fit
items.value: This ps5 gaming headset has a sustainable game time of 35-40Hrs. With RGB lighting effect turned on(15-20Hrs). Full-recharge in just 2Hrs. Ordtop noise cancelling headphones have ultra-soft protein leather earcups with memory foam padding to fit snugly over your ears. The adjustable headband ensures a secure, customized fit for a wide range of head sizes. A thoughtful and practical present for Christmas.

items.label: Sleek Circular RGB Computer headsets
items.value: Built for style and performance. Command your light: enjoy the brilliant 7-color RGB display, or double-tap to switch it off for a clean, focused look. This wireless headphones is designed for those who stand out. Let its dynamic colors amplify your gameplay, or let its sleek design make a statement in your daily life—turning every moment into an opportunity to shine.

items.label: Intuitive Controls at Your Fingertips
items.value: Easily switch between Bluetooth and 2.4GHz modes with a dedicated slider. To pair in 2.4GHz mode, simply hold the Power and Volume+ buttons for 6 seconds while the headset is off for quick adapter pairing. All other essentials—volume adjustment, RGB lighting, and mic mute—are also right on the earcup. This seamless, all-in-one control scheme makes it an ideal choice for multiplayer gaming and live streaming.

items.label: Packaging Component
items.value: Package include a bluetooth gaming headphones, USB & Type-C Plug, 3.5MM Audio Cable, Type-c Charging Cable and User Manual. Whether it’s for birthdays, holidays, or special occasions, this pc headphones makes an ideal gift for anyone who loves gaming.
